The home page's grey descriptive text is now `#3d4650`. I did not approve the two changed visual baselines, because that needs your confirmation.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`:

```css
.page-home .lede,
.page-home .card p { color: #3d4650; }
```

It is scoped to `.page-home`, so other pages are untouched. It covers 7 elements: the hero lede, the Aurora Lamp description, the three "Why Acme" perk descriptions, the newsletter blurb, and the "We never share your address" note. I left the small stat captions ("orders shipped this year" and so on) as they were, since they sit under numbers rather than headings. If you want those darkened too, say so.

**Visual tests:** the other 10 snapshots passed. `home__desktop` (0.14% of pixels) and `home__phone` (0.30%) changed, and the report says only those 7 elements were restyled with the DOM unchanged. That is the intended change.

If the new look is right, approve with `npx testivai approve home__desktop home__phone`, or tell me to and I'll do it.

STATUS: DONE
